name: Dre'Quan Priest
summary: A self-made music executive betting a strip-club fortune on discovering the next massive Vice City rap breakthrough.
description: Dre'Quan Priest leveraged profits from underground clubs and entertainment venues like the Jack of Hearts into an ambitious record label. Caught between ruthless street rivals and high-stakes label politics, Dre'Quan employs Jason and Lucia to resolve territorial disputes, protect VIP talent, and recover stolen demo master recordings.
personality: Ambitious, charismatic, streetwise, fiercely protective of his artists.

seo.title: Dre'Quan Priest: Music Mogul & Nightlife Boss
seo.description: Profile of Dre'Quan Priest in GTA VI. Music empire, strip club affiliations, recording contracts, and storyline missions.
